scope_protection.quote: No person shall perform any act that constitutes the practice of dentistry in this state unless that person is licensed under the provisions of this chapter as a dentist or a dental hygienist

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraudulent or deceptive procuring or use of a license or limited registration
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fraudulent or deceptive procuring or use of a license or limited registration

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertising dental business intended to deceive the public or advertising as a specialty without proper credentials
disciplinary_grounds.quote: All advertising of dental, dental hygiene, or DAANCE-certified maxillofacial surgery assisting business that is intended, or has a tendency, to deceive the public or a dentist advertising as a specialty in an area of dentistry unless the dentist

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a felony or a crime arising out of the practice of dentistry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of a felony; conviction of a crime arising out of the practice of dentistry, dental hygiene, or DAANCE-certified maxillofacial surgery assisting

disciplinary_grounds.description: Abandonment of a patient
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Abandonment of a patient

disciplinary_grounds.description: Dependence upon controlled substances, habitual drunkenness, or practicing while intoxicated or incapacitated by drugs
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Dependence upon controlled substances, habitual drunkenness, or rendering professional services to a patient while the dentist, dental hygienist, DAANCE-certified maxillofacial surgery assistant, or limited registrant is intoxicated or incapacitated by the use of drugs

disciplinary_grounds.description: Promoting sale of drugs, devices, or services to exploit a patient for financial gain
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Promotion by a dentist, dental hygienist, DAANCE-certified maxillofacial surgery assistant, or limited registrant of the sale of drugs, devices, appliances, or goods or services provided for a patient in a manner as to exploit the patient for the financial gain

disciplinary_grounds.description: Immoral conduct in the practice of dentistry or dental hygiene
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Immoral conduct of a dentist, dental hygienist, DAANCE-certified maxillofacial surgery assistant, or limited registrant in the practice of dentistry, dental hygiene, or DAANCE-certified maxillofacial surgery assisting

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully making and filing false reports or records in the practice of dentistry or dental hygiene
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willfully making and filing false reports or records in the practice of dentistry or dental hygiene

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to furnish details of a patient's dental record to succeeding dentists or dental care facility upon proper request
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to furnish details of a patient's dental record to succeeding dentists or dental care facility upon proper request pursuant to this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Solicitation of professional patronage by agents or profiting from acts of those representing themselves as agents
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Solicitation of professional patronage by agents or persons or profiting from acts of those representing themselves to be agents of the licensed dentist, dental hygienist, or limited registrant

disciplinary_grounds.description: Division of fees or agreeing to split fees for referring patients
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Division of fees, or agreeing to split or divide the fees, received for professional services for any person for bringing to or referring a patient

disciplinary_grounds.description: Agreeing with laboratories to accept payments for tests or work referred
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Agreeing with clinical or bioanalytical laboratories to accept payments from those laboratories for individual tests or test series for patients, or agreeing with dental laboratories to accept payment from those laboratories for work referred

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willful misrepresentation in treatments
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willful misrepresentation in treatments

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing dentistry with an unlicensed dentist or aiding unlicensed persons in the practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practicing dentistry with an unlicensed dentist or practicing dental hygiene with an unlicensed dental hygienist or practicing DAANCE-certified maxillofacial surgery assisting with an unlicensed DAANCE-certified maxillofacial surgery assistant, except in an accredited training program

disciplinary_grounds.description: Gross and willful overcharging for professional services including false billing
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Gross and willful overcharging for professional services, including filing of false statements for collection of fees for which services are not rendered, or willfully making or assisting in making a false claim or deceptive claim or misrepresenting a material fact for use in determining rights to dental care or other benefits

disciplinary_grounds.description: Offering to cure disease by secret method, procedure, or medicine
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Offering, undertaking, or agreeing to cure or treat disease by a secret method, procedure, treatment, or medicine

disciplinary_grounds.description: Professional or mental incompetence
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Professional or mental incompetence

disciplinary_grounds.description: Incompetent, negligent, or willful misconduct in the practice of dentistry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Incompetent, negligent, or willful misconduct in the practice of dentistry, dental hygiene, or DAANCE-certified maxillofacial surgery assisting, including the rendering of unnecessary dental services and any departure from, or the failure to conform to, the minimal standards of acceptable and prevailing dental, dental hygiene, or DAANCE-certified maxillofacial surgery assisting practice

disciplinary_grounds.description: Revocation, suspension, or other disciplinary action against a license in another state or jurisdiction
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Revocation, suspension, surrender, or limitation of privilege based on quality of care provided or any other disciplinary action against a license to practice dentistry, dental hygiene, or DAANCE-certified maxillofacial surgery assisting in another state or jurisdiction

disciplinary_grounds.description: Any adverse judgment, settlement, or award arising from a dental-liability claim
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any adverse judgment, settlement, or award arising from a dental-liability claim related to acts or conduct similar to acts or conduct that would constitute grounds for action as defined in this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to furnish the board legally requested information
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to furnish the board, its dental administrator, investigator, or representatives, information legally requested by the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of any provision of this chapter or the rules and regulations of the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of any provision or provisions of this chapter or the rules and regulations of the board or any rules and regulations promulgated by the director or of an action, stipulation, or agreement of the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Cheating on or attempting to subvert the licensing examination
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Cheating on or attempting to subvert the licensing examination

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating any state or federal law or regulation relating to controlled substances
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating any state or federal law or regulation relating to controlled substances

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to maintain standards established by peer-review boards
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to maintain standards established by peer-review boards, including, but not limited to, standards related to proper utilization of services, and use of nonaccepted procedure and/or quality of care

disciplinary_grounds.description: Malpractice as defined in § 5-37-1
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Malpractice as defined in § 5-37-1.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Permitting a non-dentist operator of a dental facility to interfere with the professional judgment of the dentist
disciplinary_grounds.quote: No person licensed to practice dentistry in the state of Rhode Island may permit a non-dentist who operates a dental facility in the form of a licensed outpatient healthcare center or management service organization to interfere with the professional judgment of the dentist in the practice.

definition_quote.value: Dentistry is defined as the evaluation, diagnosis, prevention, and/or treatment (nonsurgical, surgical, or related procedures) of diseases, disorders, and/or conditions of the oral cavity, cranio-maxillofacial area, and/or the adjacent and associated structures and their impact on the human body, provided by a dentist, within the scope of his or her education, training, and experience, in accordance with the ethics of the profession and applicable law.
definition_quote.quote: "Dentistry" is defined as the evaluation, diagnosis, prevention, and/or treatment (nonsurgical, surgical, or related procedures) of diseases, disorders, and/or conditions of the oral cavity, cranio-maxillofacial area, and/or the adjacent and associated structures and their impact on the human body, provided by a dentist, within the scope of his or her education, training, and experience, in accordance with the ethics of the profession and applicable law.

value: correction of malpositions of teeth or jaws
methods_authorized.quote: Extracts human teeth, corrects malpositions of the teeth or of the jaws; ... Administers an anesthetic, either general or local, in the course of any of the previously stated dental procedures; or Engages in any of the practices included in the curricula of recognized dental colleges

drug_authority.value: Dentists may prescribe and administer anesthetics and medications; must meet board requirements including ACLS/PALS training and a permit fee for non-local anesthesia.
drug_authority.quote: in order to administer any form of anesthesia, other than local, dentists must meet the requirements established by regulation of the board of examiners in dentistry, including training in advanced cardiac life support and pediatric advanced life support, and payment of a permit fee

sedation_anesthesia_permit_types.quote: Those regulations shall be consistent with the American Dental Association guidelines for the use of conscious sedation, deep sedation, and general anesthesia in dentistry. Neither the board, nor any regulation promulgated by the board, shall require additional licensing fees for the use of nitrous oxide by dentists.

specialty_advertising_disclaimer_require.quote: a dentist advertising as a specialty in an area of dentistry unless the dentist: (i) Is a diplomat of or a fellow in a specialty board accredited or recognized by the American Dental Association; or (ii) Has completed a postgraduate program approved by the Commission on Dental Accreditation of the American Dental Association

value: public health setting (without immediate or direct supervision)
dental_hygienist_supervision_levels.quote: A dental hygienist is only permitted to practice dental hygiene under the general supervision of a dentist licensed and registered in this state under the provisions of this chapter.

collaborative_agreement_available.quote: Any public-health hygienist shall enter into a written, collaborative agreement with a local or state government agency or institution or with a licensed dentist

advanced_practice_permit_available.quote: Any public health dental hygienist, which for purposes of this chapter means any practicing registered dental hygienist who may perform dental-hygiene procedures in a public-health setting subject to conditions adopted by the Rhode Island board of examiners in dentistry, may perform in a public-health setting, without the immediate or direct supervision or direction of a dentist

value: nursing home and long-term-care facility residents
mobile and portable dental-health program patients
other facilities or programs deemed appropriate by the department of health
advanced_practice_eligible_patient_popul.quote: Public-health settings shall, for purposes of this section, include, but are not limited to, residences of the homebound, schools, nursing home and long-term-care facilities, clinics, hospitals, medical facilities, community health centers licensed or certified by the department of health, mobile and portable dental-health programs licensed or certified by the department of health and operated by a local or state agency, head-start programs, and any other facilities or programs deemed appropriate by the department of health.

dental_office_ownership_restrictions.quote: No non-dentist who operates a dental facility in the form of a licensed outpatient healthcare center or management service organization may interfere with the professional judgment of a dentist in the practice.

dental_laboratory_work_authorization_req.quote: Except on the written prescription of a licensed dentist and by the use of impressions or casts made by a licensed and practicing dentist, directly or indirectly by mail, carrier, personal agent, or by any other method, furnishes, supplies, constructs, reproduces, or repairs prosthetic dentures, bridges, appliances, or other structures to be used and worn as substitutes for natural teeth

teledentistry_authorized.quote: Professionals licensed under this chapter utilizing telemedicine in the practice of dentistry are subject to the same standard of care that would apply to the provision of the same dental care service or procedure in an in-person setting.

hygienist_local_anesthesia_certification.quote: in order to administer local injectable anesthesia to dental patients, dental hygienists must be under the supervision of a dentist and meet the requirements established by regulation of the board of examiners in dentistry including payment of a permit fee.

cpr_certification_required_for_sedation.quote: in order to administer any form of anesthesia, other than local, dentists must meet the requirements established by regulation of the board of examiners in dentistry, including training in advanced cardiac life support and pediatric advanced life support, and payment of a permit fee.

dental_hygienist_alternative_practice_li.quote: Any public health dental hygienist, which for purposes of this chapter means any practicing registered dental hygienist who may perform dental-hygiene procedures in a public-health setting subject to conditions adopted by the Rhode Island board of examiners in dentistry, may perform in a public-health setting, without the immediate or direct supervision or direction of a dentist
